data.name: Wendelin
data.gender_notes: Wendelin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old German name Windalini, meaning 'friend' and 'wind'. In Christian tradition, Saint Wendelin is the patron saint of hunters, woodcutters, and lost causes. He is said to have lived in the forest and survived by learning to control the winds to keep warm and cook his meals. The name Wendelin carries the meaning “Friend of the winds” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Wendelin usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the winds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of resilience and survival, embodying the human spirit's ability to adapt and thrive in challenging conditions.
data.etymology: Wendelin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the winds.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wendelin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: ונדלין
in_hebrew.meaning: השם ונדלין מתייחס לאוהב הנדודים או למי שמטייל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ונדלין הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הגרמני 'וינדולינוס', שמתורגם לאוהב הנדודים או למי שמטייל. השם נגזר מהמילים הגרמניות 'וינד' שפירושו נדודים ו'לין' שפירושו אוהב או מקורב. השם ונדלין משויך לקדוש הנוצרי ונדלין הקדוש, שהיה איש כמורה גרמני מהמאה ה-7.

in_greek.name: Ουεντελίν
in_greek.meaning: Ουεντελίν σημαίνει αυτό που αγαπάει να περιφέρεται
in_greek.long_meaning: Ουεντελίν, ένα χριστιανικό όνομα, προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Wendolinus', που σημαίνει αυτό που αγαπάει να περιφέρεται ή να ταξιδεύει. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος σχετίζεται με τις γερμανικές λέξεις 'Wend' που σημαίνει περιφορά και 'Lin' που σημαίνει αγαπητός ή φίλος. Ο Ουεντελίν είναι επίσης το όνομα ενός χριστιανού αγίου, του Αγίου Ουεντελίν, ενός Γερμανού ιερέα του 7ου αιώνα.

in_latin.name: Wendelin
in_latin.meaning: Wendelin means one who loves to wander
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Wendelin, of Germanic origin, translates to one who loves to wander or travel. It is derived from the Old High German words 'wint' meaning wanderer and 'lin' meaning friend or lover. Saint Wendelin, a 7th-century German priest, bears this name, signifying a connection to the early Christian church and its missionary traditions.

in_english.name: Wendelin
in_english.meaning: Wendelin means a wanderer or one who loves to travel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Wendelin, with its roots in Germanic languages, signifies a person who loves to wander or travel. Etymologically, it is linked to the Old High German words 'wint' (wanderer) and 'lin' (friend or lover). Historically, Saint Wendelin, a 7th-century German priest known for his piety and dedication to the poor, carried this name. The name Wendelin has been used across Christian cultures, symbolizing a free spirit and a love for journeying, whether physically or spiritually.

data.cultural_impact: Saint Wendelin is revered in parts of Europe, particularly in Germany and Austria, as the patron saint of hunters and woodcutters due to his legendary control over the winds. His story and symbolism have influenced forest communities and their connection to the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: Saint Wendelin's spiritual significance lies in his unwavering determination and resilience in the face of adversity. Living in the forest isolated from human society, he maintained his faith in a higher power andarness to the elements. His story serves as an inspiration to continue praying and trusting in God, especially during difficult times or when feeling lost.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Wendelin, meaning "friend of the elves" in Old High German, symbolizes the unity and harmony between the natural world and the divine. It encourages a deep reverence for the beauty of creation and the wisdom of the earth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Wendelin was a name borne by several saints in the Middle Ages. The name Wendelin carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Wendelin continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
